description:
Set in an enviable position which could arguably be described as one of the most central locations available in Glasgow City Centre. The apartment has been very cleverly designed to offer an abundance of free-flowing space.

The building is accessed via a security controlled front gate with a lift leading to all levels and the development is within a section of the Vienna Apartments Development, completed around 2009 by Burrell Homes.

The accommodation comprises long hallway leading to all rooms. The bedroom benefits from laminate flooring and fitted wardrobe. The open plan living room/kitchen offers plentiful natural light from the floor to ceiling windows and benefits from its own private balcony looking out on to Mitchell Street.
The modern fitted kitchen houses an integrated fridge freezer and dishwasher and the bathroom is spacious with a mains shower over the bath.

The property further benefits from double glazing, electric heating and a large hall storage cupboard housing a washer dryer and hot water tank.

Parking permits are available at nearby Mitchell Street NCP or the Q-Park in Jamaica Street.

We have a current EWS 1 form which details that no remedial works to the cladding are required.

Mitchell Street is in the heart of Glasgow City Centre and the location offers unquestionably one of the most envied and prominent social locations Glasgow has to offer with a wealth of amenities including both general and specialist shopping, wine bars and many highly acclaimed restaurants.
It is also conveniently located for access to the Merchant City and is in close proximity to Strathclyde & Caledonian Universities and the Glasgow School of Art.

The area benefits from frequent public transport with easy access to Central and Queen Street Train Stations, and St Enoch subway stations. Public transport and road links are exceptional.

Energy Efficiency Rating - C
